Polymers for

Smaller, higher-performing electronics need better thermal management and electrical insulation. Synboli offers tailored solutions for next-generation devices.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
electronics.

Miniaturisation and higher performance increase demands on thermal management and insulation. Synboli’s examples span device structures, protective encapsulation and energy-related polymer applications.

Synboli modifies PC and PA for thinner, durable smartphone structures. Silicone and PMMA support stable LED encapsulation and lenses. PVDF and PTFE improve battery binders, while PEEK and PVDF support flexible substrates and active layers for organic solar cells.
